# real_failures/

Engine logs of real failed starts, induced on purpose on a DGX Spark with `scripts/decider_eval/induce_failures.py`
(public models only). Each file's header names the label, engine, model, exit code and how the failure was induced.
Used by the diagnosis rules and their evaluation (`tests/test_real_corpus.py`, docs/decider-evaluation.md).
Generated by this project; credentials, host names and addresses are redacted.
